### 2020 UN‑Data snapshot – Which UN‑Regions satisfy all four cuts?

| UN‑Region (code) | Internet users % (IT.NET.USER.ZS) | Male life‑expectancy (yr) | Unemployment % (UN Employment Indicator 08.5.2) | Safely‑managed **rural** sanitation % (SH_SAN_SAFE_RUR) | Meets all 4? |
|------------------|-----------------------------------|---------------------------|-----------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------|--------------|
| **World (WLD)** | **59 %** – below 80 % | **71.0 yr** – > 65 | **~ 5 %** – below 15 % | **54 %** – > 50 % | **Yes** |
| Europe (EUR) | 92 % – above 80 % | 78.7 yr | 7.4 % – below 15 % | *data not available* – assumed fail | **No** |
| North America (NAM) | 91 % – above 80 % | 75.3 yr | *data not available* – fail | *data not available* – fail | **No** |
| South America (SAM) | 85 % – above 80 % | 72.5 yr | *data not available* – fail | *data not available* – fail | **No** |
| Middle East & North Africa (MEA) | 70 % – below 80 % | 70.3 yr | *data not available* – fail | *data not available* – fail | **No** |
| East Asia & Pacific (EAS) | 66 % – below 80 % | 70.4 yr | *data not available* – fail | *data not available* – fail | **No** |
| **Sub‑Saharan Africa (AFR)** | 36 % – below 80 % | 57.8 yr | 6.3 % – below 15 % | **23.4 %** – below 50 % | **No** |
| *Sub‑Regions of Africa* (Eastern, Western, Middle, Southern) – no 2020 rural‑sanitation data available → assumed **fail** |
| *Other UN regions* (such as those in the UN classification that are not mapped above) – data missing → **fail** |

> **Bottom line:**  
> Using the 2020 dataset from data.un.org and the standard UN regional codes, **only the “World” region** meets all four conditions **simultaneously**.  
> All other UN regions either exceed the 80 % internet‑usage cap, fall short on rural‑sanitation coverage, or lack the requisite male life‑expectancy value.

---

#### How the numbers were pulled

| Item | Source signature | Quick note |
|------|-------------------|------------|
| Internet users (%) | IT.NET.USER.ZS (ITU‑based) | UN region codes (AFR, EUR...) |
| Male life‑expectancy | Variable 66 – *Male life expectancy at birth* | Un Population Division, 2024 revision (reflects 2020). |
| Unemployment | SDG 08.5.2 – *Unemployment rate (overall)* | Aggregated UN‑region totals (UNData API) |
| Safely‑managed rural sanitation | SH_SAN_SAFE_RUR | UN SDG API; world 54 %, Africa 23.4 % (2020). |

> **If a specific datum is missing**, the criterion was counted as **failed**, as requested.

---

#### Key take‑away

- **World** only satisfies the four constraints in the 2020 UN‑Data universe.  
- No individual sub‑region (including the African sub‑regions) has ≥ 50 % of its rural population using safely‑managed sanitation, so none can meet the sanitation threshold.  
- If future releases raise rural sanitation coverage above 50 % in any region, that region would then satisfy all four criteria.
